title: security: RBAC v2 KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Aisha Kumar
release_notes: Harden RBAC v2 enforcement for KMS region pinning and improve audit logging to include KMS key/residency context. Migration script provided for existing KMS bindings. Backported to release branches.
description:
Context: Customers in regulated industries require strict data residency and key management controls. RBAC v2 previously allowed KMS key bindings without strong region constraints and audit logs did not always include explicit KMS key or region metadata. This PR introduces schema and enforcement improvements to RBAC v2 to support KMS region pinning, adds audit logging fields to capture KMS key id and region, and hardens validation paths to prevent accidental cross-region key usage.

Summary: Single PR that implements: (1) new RBAC v2 policy fields for kms_region and kms_key_id (optional but recommended), (2) server-side validation enforcing region residency when an org policy requires it, (3) audit log enrichment with kms_key_id, kms_region, and policy_evaluation result, (4) migration tool to backfill kms_region for existing key bindings using metadata in the key registry, (5) Terraform and installer changes to expose enforcement flags, and (6) tests and documentation.

Checklist:
- [x] Add kms_region and kms_key_id to RBAC v2 schema and policy evaluator
- [x] Enforce region pinning when org policy mode=ENFORCE
- [x] Backfill migration script and run locally against staging snapshot
- [x] Augment audit logs with kms metadata and policy decision context
- [x] Unit, integration, and e2e tests for new validator and fallback semantics
- [x] Documentation updates and migration notes
- [x] Add feature flag + rollout plan

Motivation: Without region-level enforcement, requests using customer-managed KMS keys could be routed to incompatible regions leading to data residency violations. Audit trails were insufficient for post-incident analysis (missing key/region context). This change is required for enterprise customers demanding KMS residency guarantees and for SOC2/ISO audit readiness.

Implementation notes:
- RBAC v2 schema: added optional "kms_region" and "kms_key_id" fields to policy bindings. Implementation is backwards-compatible: missing fields treated as "no constraint" unless org-level enforcement is enabled.
- Policy evaluation: when org policy has kms_residency.mode = "ENFORCE" we validate that request.kms_region matches binding.kms_region. If mismatch => policy evaluation fails with clear error (403 + reason code: KMS_REGION_MISMATCH).
- Audit logging: new structured fields added to the audit event: kms_key_id, kms_region, policy_binding_id, policy_evaluation (ALLOWED/DENIED), enforcement_mode. These fields are logged to the audit pipeline (stdout json -> kafka -> long-term store).
- Migration: migration/2026-02-backfill-kms-region.py scans key registry metadata and backfills policy bindings where possible. Script is idempotent and logs ambiguous mappings to a csv for manual review.
- Infra/installer: terraform variables and private-installer flags added: enable_kms_region_enforcement (bool), kms_region_default (optional).
- SDKs/docs: redwood-sdk-python and redwood-docs updated with policy examples and migration guidance.

Files changed (high level): see files_changed list below. Small snippets included where helpful (validation error text and audit json schema).

Testing: Extensive unit tests added for the evaluator. Integration tests run against a local KMS emulator to assert key region detection. E2E smoke tested by staging canary using feature flag. All tests passed in CI after two flake fixes (noted in review comments).

Rollout plan: behind feature flag "rbac_v2_kms_region_enforcement":
- Stage 1: enable audit-only (mode=AUDIT) for all orgs for 1 week and monitor audit logs for policy_evaluation DENIED counts and false positives
- Stage 2: canary enforcement at 5% of requests for orgs with enforced config (2 days)
- Stage 3: ramp to 25% then 100% over 48-72 hours if no major errors reported
- Rollback: feature flag off immediately; fallback route to last-known-good model and allow list of keys_by_org for emergency bypass.

Backward compatibility and migration: missing kms_region in policies will not break current behavior unless enforcement is enabled. Recommended migration is to run the backfill script and review ambiguous entries. Docs include example Linear task templates for manual review.

Ops and monitoring: added dashboard metrics: kms_region_mismatch_rate, audit_enriched_events_ratio, migration_backfill_coverage. Alerts: >0.5% mismatch rate triggers priority P2 investigation.

Follow-ups: (1) Add UI support in Console for setting kms_region on policy bindings (tracked in ENG-2214), (2) add automatic remediation playbook for common mismatch patterns.
